name: transcribe-so
description: Transcribe audio and video (YouTube, podcasts, uploads) into speaker-labelled transcripts with chapters, cited Q&A, word timings, subtitles, and hosted captioned clips, via the transcribe.so remote MCP server.

transcribe-so.note: Official transcribe.so MCP server (hosted, streamable HTTP). OAuth on first connection, or a tsk_live_* API key as a Bearer token.
